schedule: Four serial input variants with fixed seed/dose/model/dynamics/readout/local rule and identical archived verified teaching experiences across variants and controls. Own before/after Monte Carlo investigation is measured separately; it does not change the common teaching schedule. Same pilot gates as preserved positive-puzzle V1. No outcome-derived cue features.
scope: Exploratory single-seed familiar-fixture input-factor comparison. Per-variant passes are not between-variant significance, unfamiliar transfer, reasoning or biological validation. A selected repair requires frozen independent confirmation. All prior failures preserved.
acceptance: Pilot useful-choice gate: both informative fixtures end with independently verified successful unaided choices; at least one formerly failing fixture improves, while its absent and disabled matched controls remain failing. Require exact causal reset/restoration and independently audited persistence/unknown handling, channel counts, local recurrence, fixed wiring and after-update recovery. Report shuffled and punishment-only results explicitly; this single-seed pilot does not establish statistical specificity or transfer.
